# tbox compatibility fixtures

These fixtures pin the image archive format tbox shares with tariboy
(`internal/image`). Both modules read them.

- `skills/hello-skill` and `skills/hello-skill.tree_sha256`: the skill tree
  hash, checked by `tbox/internal/skill`.
- `v2-basic/`: a schema-v2 source with one local skill, one prompt file,
  `image_version` and `ROLE.md`. It uses no `extends`, plugins or runtime
  entries, so tbox and tariboy build the same content from it.
- `v2-basic.digest`: the content digest of `v2-basic` built under the name
  `compat-basic`. It was generated by tariboy (`TestTboxCompatDigest` in
  `internal/image/tbox_compat_test.go`); `TestCompatDigest` in
  `tbox/internal/archive` requires tbox to produce the same value. Never edit
  it to make tbox pass: find the byte difference instead.
- `v3-marked/`: a schema-v3 source with plugins, runtime entries and
  `only: tariboy` entries next to a normal skill and prompts (image name
  `compat-marked`).
- `v3-marked.tar.gz`: the archive tbox builds from `v3-marked`. tariboy's
  `TestTboxArchiveImports` validates it as an import does. Regenerate it with
  `cd tbox && go test ./internal/archive -run TestCompatMarkedArchive -update-compat`.
- `v3-marked.tariboy-image.tar.gz`: the `v3-marked.tar.gz` image in the
  tariboy portable envelope (`kind: image-artifact`, ref `compat-marked:latest`,
  producer `tbox-0.0.0`) that `tbox image export` writes. tariboy's
  `TestTboxPortableImports` (`internal/imageportable`) previews and applies it;
  `TestCompatPortableArchive` in `tbox/internal/portable` reads it. Regenerate it
  with `cd tbox && go test ./internal/portable -run TestCompatPortableArchive -update-compat`.
- `skills-lock/skill` and `skills-lock/computedHash`: the `computedHash` that
  tariboy's `stores.SkillHash` (`internal/stores/skillslock.go`) gives the
  skill directory, as the skills installer writes it into `skills-lock.json`.
  The file names exercise the localeCompare order. `TestHashMatchesTariboy` in
  `tbox/internal/skillslock` requires `skillslock.Hash` to give the same value;
  it adds the skipped `.git` and `node_modules` directories to a copy, since
  neither can be committed.
- `v2-tariboy/`: a schema-v2 source with the built-in plugin `whoami`, a
  minimal fixture skill `whoami` that satisfies its contract, and the runtime
  entries `identity` and `user-prompt` around one file prompt (image name
  `compat-tariboy`).
- `v2-tariboy.tariboy-image.tar.gz`: the envelope tariboy's own
  `imageportable.Service.Export` writes for `v2-tariboy` built by `BuildV2`.
  `TestTboxTariboyEnvelope` (`internal/imageportable`) requires a fresh
  tariboy build to have the digest it records; `TestImportTariboyExport` in
  `tbox/internal/portable` imports it, reads the inner archive and checks the
  run directory prompt leaves the runtime entries out. Regenerate it with
  `go test ./internal/imageportable -run TestTboxTariboyEnvelope -update-tbox-compat`
  from the repository root.
- `runtimes.txt`, `skill-categories.txt`, `plugin-name.txt`: the format lists
  tbox copies from tariboy. tariboy's `TestTboxRuntimeList`
  (`internal/imagecontract`), `TestTboxSkillCategories` and
  `TestTboxPluginNamePattern` (`internal/image`) check them against its code;
  `TestRuntimeNamesMatchCompatList` (`tbox/internal/tfile`) and
  `TestFormatListsMatchCompatFiles` (`tbox/internal/archive`) check them
  against tbox. When tariboy changes a list, update the file and the tbox copy
  together.
